titulo: Israelis mourn on 3rd anniversary of Oct. 7 attacks as Palestinians grapple with war it sparked
cuerpo: Israelis gathered on Wednesday to commemorate the Oct. 7, 2023, Hamas-led attacks that killed 1,200 people, saw 251 taken hostage and sparked a devastating war in Gaza that has left much of the territory in ruins and its two million people living in dire conditions.
